name: modsmith
description: A workbench for building Claude Code mods: which mods loaded, a live tape of every event with its real payload, the four ship gates on the mod in progress, and tools so Claude can read payloads and run the gates itself

tools.title: Tools for Claude
tools.description: Register the events, gates and mods tools so Claude can read real payloads and run the gates itself. Their descriptions add a few hundred tokens to every request.

autoValidate.title: Validate on reload
autoValidate.description: Run claude plugin validate on a dev mod each time it reloads, for the band above the prompt.

recordAppends.title: Record transcript rows
recordAppends.description: Also record session.append, which fires on every transcript row and floods the tape.

cliPath.title: claude executable
cliPath.description: The claude CLI the gates run, when it is not on the app's PATH.

npxPath.title: npx executable
npxPath.description: The npx the types gate runs, when it is not on the app's PATH.
